ambiguities.statement: The authoritative inventory contains six ordered feature entries and the domain-finalization manifest declares expected_feature_count=6, but feature-status.yaml contains neither feature_count nor population_count although tools/handoff/validate_handoff.py currently requires one of those fields.
ambiguities.preservation: The six-entry authoritative population is used without fabricating metadata. No protected source or validator is modified.

ambiguities.statement: Language, concrete value types, ownership, allocation, layout, concurrency, and serialization format are not scientifically or globally prescribed.
ambiguities.preservation: Only observable structural behavior is constrained; unspecified runtime properties remain implementation-defined or not constrained.

ambiguities.statement: No ontology, time model, existence predicate, or scientific oracle is available for the preexistence claim.
ambiguities.preservation: The output exposes verification_status=unavailable_without_oracle and never produces a truth value.

ambiguities.statement: Existential classification, energetic semantics, and scientific acceptance criteria are undefined.
ambiguities.preservation: The descriptor exposes oracle_acceptance_rule=unresolved_propagated and contains no acceptance decision.

ambiguities.statement: Scientific hierarchy, state-transition semantics, application validity, transmission mechanics, audience, medium, encoding, transport, and execution are not supplied.
ambiguities.preservation: The packages remain structural only and propagate every routed unresolved identifier and reservation.

ambiguities.statement: Algorithm artefacts provide total step lists, but the finalization evidence only makes selected validation, preservation, source-order, and failure-before-success relationships observable.
ambiguities.preservation: All operations use partially_constrained strategies. No total implementation sequence is imposed merely because an upstream file lists steps.

ambiguities.statement: Several local structures repeat evidence-envelope, exact-population, and source-order patterns, but domain finalization explicitly declines factorization without scientific equivalence.
ambiguities.preservation: No shared contract is created or modified. Candidate-only observations are recorded separately.

ambiguities.statement: The fixed domain-catalog schema has no per-package hash property although the task requests calculable hashes.
ambiguities.preservation: The catalog stores exact paths, versions, order, and source commit. Package hashes remain calculable from Git blobs and trees without changing a global schema.
